title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single loop. Start by drawing the first arc from the point (0.0, 0.0203) to (0.0203, 0.0), passing through (0.0059, 0.0059). Next, draw the first line from (0.0203, 0.0) to (0.7297, 0.0). Follow this with the second arc from (0.7297, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0203), passing through (0.7441, 0.0059). Then, draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0203) to (0.75, 0.1216). Continue with the third arc from (0.75, 0.1216) to (0.7297, 0.1419), passing through (0.7441, 0.136). Draw the third line from (0.7297, 0.1419) to (0.0203, 0.1419). Add the fourth arc from (0.0203, 0.1419) to (0.0, 0.1216), passing through (0.0059, 0.136). Finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.1216) back to (0.0, 0.0203) to close the loop. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions without applying any rotation or translation. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0101 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular plate with rounded edges. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the part are 0.75 units in length, 0.1418918918918919 units in width, and 0.010135135135135136 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Create the arcs and lines
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0203).threePointArc((0.0059, 0.0059), (0.0203, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.7297, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.7441, 0.0059), (0.75, 0.0203))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.75, 0.1216)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.7441, 0.136), (0.7297, 0.1419))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0203, 0.1419)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0059, 0.136), (0.0, 0.1216))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0, 0.0203)

# Close the sketch
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch

# Plate dimensions
L = 0.7500
W = 0.1419
T = 0.0101
corner_r = 0.0300

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(L, W, T, centered=(False, False, False))
    .edges("|Z")
    .fillet(corner_r)
)

# Small chamfer-like edge detail on top/bottom perimeter
r = r.faces(">Z").edges().chamfer(0.002)
